domains.name: admin
domains.responsibility: Administrasi sistem, analitik penggunaan, log audit, dan manajemen pengguna multi-tenant.

domains.name: auth
domains.responsibility: Autentikasi Supabase, proteksi rute, manajemen sesi, profil, dan token anonim.

domains.name: collaboration
domains.responsibility: Publikasi web instan, kontrol akses bertingkat, bulk publishing, dan presence.

domains.name: editor
domains.responsibility: Editor teks CodeMirror 6, live preview, syntax highlighting, properties panel, slash commands.

domains.name: graph
domains.responsibility: Visual engine 2D/3D (XMind + Force), pemecah layout pohon/timeline, atmosphere, styling warna.

domains.name: metadata
domains.responsibility: Ekstraksi wikilinks, indexing unlinked mentions via Aho-Corasick worker, tag graph.

domains.name: public-reader
domains.responsibility: Portal baca publik anonim (/p/:user/:vault/:slug) berkinerja tinggi tanpa login.

domains.name: settings
domains.responsibility: Preferensi pengguna, tema gelap kosmik, sinkronisasi cloud config, dan skema.

domains.name: sync
domains.responsibility: Sinkronisasi offline, penanganan antrean mutasi IndexedDB, dan rekonsiliasi remote.

domains.name: vault
domains.responsibility: Driver penyimpanan berkas (FS API, IndexedDB, Supabase), impor/ekspor akumulatif, backup.

domains.name: vcs
domains.responsibility: Sistem kontrol versi internal (mikro-revisi, stashing, branching, 3-way conflict resolver).

domains.name: workspace
domains.responsibility: Manajemen tata letak VS Code-style (tabs, split panes, ribbons, sidebars, context menus).
